title: Venice Beach LA Food Tour
includes: An amazing guide who tells fun and interesting stories about the neighborhood
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
See and taste the best that Venice Beach has to offer on a one-of-a-kind Sidewalk Food Tour!

Our food tour includes five unique stops showcasing the best of the neighborhood’s renowned food scene. Our expert guides have done extensive (and delicious!) research to offer you the ultimate tasting tour of the Venice neighborhood of Los Angeles.

Sidewalk Food Tours is built on a deep love of food, history, and the unique stories of different neighborhoods within each city in which we offer tours. You’ll feel as if you’re exploring the city with a close friend who wants to show you all their favorite local spots.

We look forward to having you join us on a Sidewalk Food Tour of Venice and can’t wait to show you the sights!

Buen Provecho!
